product_one_liner.value: ComplyAdvantage provides an AI-native financial-crime risk platform for regulated organizations, helping them screen customers and businesses, monitor transactions and payments, and automate AML/KYC compliance workflows.
product_one_liner.notes: The product overview describes ComplyAdvantage Mesh and its financial-crime screening and monitoring applications.

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page lists a Starter plan with prices and an Enterprise plan priced on application.

named_customers.notes: These names are presented on the company's customer-stories page.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn's company profile lists the company size as 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: The company profile identifies London, England as headquarters.

founded_year.notes: The company profile lists its founding year as 2014.

eng_blog.notes: The separate Technology Blog includes multiple engineering/product-building posts, including “Building a Personalised Code Review Agent by Mining My GitLab History” and “Beyond the _reindex API: A Blue-Green Strategy for Zero-Downtime Elasticsearch.”

public_docs.notes: The public API documentation contains multiple sections and articles covering authentication, endpoints, concepts, case/client management, and webhooks.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: A live ComplyAdvantage posting is titled Principal Machine Learning Engineer.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed the company's AI-platform article and public API documentation for provider/model disclosures. The AI article describes proprietary/in-house models and model types such as LLMs and NLP, but does not identify a specific external model provider or named model.

compliance_certs.notes: The article states ISO 27001 and SOC 2 compliance and GDPR-compliant solutions/data handling. It does not name HIPAA or PCI DSS.

last_funding.notes: The May 20, 2021 announcement says the Series C was extended to $70 million; the newly added Goldman Sachs investment amount itself was undisclosed.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest funding announcement located is dated May 20, 2021, outside the 18-month window preceding 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A current ComplyAdvantage posting is for a Business Development Representative.

launched_6mo.notes: On May 19, 2026, the company announced the launch of Payment Screening on its Mesh platform, within the six months before 2026-11-09.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The full leadership team page was reviewed and press announcements checked; no C-level or VP-level join or departure within 2025-11-09 through 2026-11-09 was found. The identified VP Sales appointment was in April 2024, outside the window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable company integration and careers pages reviewed did not name a CRM or sales/marketing platform.
